options: Data joined from fact and dimension tables and loaded into one table with multi-dimensional data pre-loaded
A virtual view over source systems
questions.explanation: When data is joined from fact and dimension tables and loaded into one table it is called an OLAP cube; the multi-dimensional data is pre-loaded so queries can be super-fast.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a listed disadvantage of OLAP cubes?
options: They are very difficult to refresh in real time
They are seen by many as not worth having
questions.explanation: Cubes are huge, hard to refresh in real time and challenging to house-keep, but their whole point is that queries are super-fast.

questions.stem: Which OLAP type sits directly on top of an RDBMS star or snowflake schema and can be built with standard SQL?
questions.explanation: ROLAP (Relational OLAP) sits directly on top of the RDBMS, can be built using standard SQL, and needs no additional storage.

questions.stem: Cubes are the best example of which OLAP type?
questions.explanation: Cubes are the best example of MOLAP (Multi-dimensional OLAP), where multi-dimensional data is loaded into separate storage in an extremely fast manner.

questions.stem: What is a cube with more than three dimensions of data called?
questions.explanation: If a cube has more than three dimensions of data in it, it is called a hypercube.

questions.stem: Which operations can users perform within a single MOLAP cube without joining other tables?
options: Slice, dice, drill up and down, roll up and pivot
questions.explanation: Using cubes, users can slice, dice, drill up or down, roll up and pivot the data within the same cube, eliminating the need to join with other tables.

options: A hybrid mixture of ROLAP and MOLAP
A web-only OLAP accessed through a browser
An in-memory system doing both OLTP and OLAP
An offline desktop portion of OLAP
questions.explanation: HOLAP (Hybrid OLAP) is a mixture of ROLAP and MOLAP.

questions.stem: Which OLAP type allows users to download a portion of the OLAP data to their own machine for offline working?
questions.explanation: DOLAP (Desktop OLAP) lets users download a portion of OLAP onto their machine for offline working.

questions.stem: What is SOLAP designed to tackle?
options: Issues in the field of geo-business intelligence
questions.explanation: SOLAP (Spatial OLAP) is designed to tackle issues in the field of geo-business intelligence.

questions.stem: What is a benefit of ROLAP over MOLAP with respect to storage?
options: ROLAP compresses cubes to half their size
ROLAP needs no additional storage because it runs on top of the RDBMS
ROLAP downloads data to the desktop
ROLAP stores data only in the browser
questions.explanation: ROLAP does not need additional storage as it runs on top of the RDBMS, whereas MOLAP loads multi-dimensional data into separate storage.
